item.title: Oklahoma’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1931. On 12 acres. $5,600,000
item.description: Welcome to Oklahoma’s most expensive old house listing! This sure is beautiful! Love the property! The house was built in 1931. It is located on 12 acres in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The house features a beautiful barrel ceiling, five fireplaces, updated kitchen and an elevator. There is a five car garage, large pool, stocked pond, tennis court and a cabana kitchen. item.title: Pretty house! Circa 1803. Almost five acres in Vermont. $529,000
item.description: This is a pretty house and it has a pretty setting! The house was built in 1803. It is located on 4.8 acres in Chester, Vermont. The house features exposed beams, wood floors, a spacious kitchen, built-in china cabinet, wainscoting, chair rails, baseboards and an attic for storage. There is an attached garage and a large barn. Five bedrooms, five bathrooms and 3,880 square feet. $529,000 Contact Daire Gibney with Barrett and Valley Associates: 802-875-2323 From the Zillow listing: Built in 1803,

The cabin features a large deck, vaulted ceiling, wood floors and bead board. There is a small bunkhouse on the property. The cabin is on US forest service land so the lot is under an annual lease. item.description: This house has potential! They place all the value in the acreage, but I have seen worse. The house was built in 1923. It is located on 14.68 acres in Powhatan, Virginia. item.title: TWO houses on 11 acres in West Virginia! Pretty setting with a pond. $399,900
item.description: This listing includes two houses! There is some nice acreage and it’s a pretty setting with a pond. The house was built in 1946. It is located on 11.5 acres in Alderson, West Virginia. Both houses could use some updating, but there is great potential there. One house is three bedrooms and one bathroom. The other is four bedrooms and two bathrooms. There is a nice pond and multiple outbuildings on the property. Seven bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,924 square feet. $399,900 Contact David and Cynd

item.title: Almost 10,000 square feet! Basement is so cool! C. 1926 in Wisconsin. $625,000
item.description: This seems like a lot of house for the money! I love that basement! It’s a big house with almost 10,000 square feet. The house was built in 1926. It is located on .36 acre in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The house features wood floors, grand staircase, arched windows with stained glass, baseboards, paneled den, crown moulding, vintage tiled bathrooms, built-in bookshelves, slate roof, basement with english style pub and built-in china cabinets.
